english: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
text: carry seven passengers 讲的是载客容量，不说明这次实际已经坐了七个人。介绍车辆性能时可说 can carry；描述眼下乘客数量则直接说 there are seven passengers，别把能力当成现场事实。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
